datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Ethiopia to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC phase classifications (ranging from minimal to catastrophic food insecurity) were compiled for multiple scenarios and time periods throughout 2021, with results distributed as monthly GeoJSON and KML files.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys to assess acute food insecurity severity and affected populations across Ethiopia.
